description: This file defines the 'EscaperNodeVisitor' class, which is a part of Twig, a templating engine for PHP. The class implements a node visitor that adds automatic escaping behavior to template nodes based on context, ensuring output safety by wrapping expressions in escape filters as needed.

classes.name:
Twig
odevisitor\EscaperNodeVisitor
classes.description: A final class implementing NodeVisitorInterface to automatically insert escape filters into Twig templates based on context, preventing XSS vulnerabilities. It manages node traversal, detects nodes requiring escaping, and applies the escape filter accordingly.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EscaperNodeVisitor with an internal SafeAnalysisNodeVisitor instance for security analysis.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Handles logic when entering a node during traversal; manages escaping state and safe variables.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Handles logic when leaving a node during traversal; applies escaping to PrintNodes and manages node-specific state.

methods.name: escapeConditional
methods.description: Recursively escapes operands within expressions that implement OperatorEscapeInterface.

methods.name: escapeExpression
methods.description: Wraps an expression in an escape filter if it is not already safe.

methods.name: preEscapeFilterNode
methods.description: Prepares a FilterExpression node for escaping based on its pre-escape configuration.

methods.name: isSafeFor
methods.description: Determines if an expression is safe for a given context by analyzing safe variables.

methods.name: needEscaping
methods.description: Returns whether the current node should be escaped based on the internal stack and default strategy.

methods.name: getEscaperFilter
methods.description: Creates a FilterExpression that applies an escape filter to a given expression.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this node visitor, here it is 0.
